benchmarkAffinity: logical CPU 3 via taskset; no exclusive CPU reservation

measurementScopes.indexBuildNanoseconds: diagnostic construction time under cProfile; excluded from timing gate
measurementScopes.indexOwnedContainerBytes: shallow sizes of owned dict/list/tuple containers; row, string and integer objects (RBH ordinals and cursor offsets) excluded
measurementScopes.inputDataFrameDeepBytes: pandas deep bytes of retained case input frames; excludes protein maps, Bio records, raw buffers and prepared results
measurementScopes.stagePeakBytes: one tracemalloc invocation after fixture preparation, no warmup; only allocations inside the stage
measurementScopes.processMaxRssKiB: entire memory-run process including fixtures, retained inputs, imports, serializer and reports

hostObservation: unsandboxed WSL /proc sampled every 10 seconds; Windows processes not visible; background git add and editor load retained
